component_scope.business_outcome: Unassessed; wrong business predicates or text do not by themselves violate source shape.
component_scope.finite_inputs: Only the individually hashed immutable public fixture packet is admitted; arbitrary inputs and universal arithmetic safety are unassessed.
component_scope.framework_reconciliation: Deterministic onChange, guarded parameter reconciliation, or SideEffect without suspension/IO is local framework reconciliation, not external async.
prohibited: off-axis scroll or independently occluded content surfaces
popup, sheet, menu, dialog or foreground overlay
suspending, asynchronous or IO-driven business paths
fixture-index lookup or forced view identity reset
component_scope.root: One eager main vertical stack or column; finite section stacks and row labels are in that same content flow.
component_scope.state: Finite local selection/confirmation/receipt state and deterministic synchronous parameter reconciliation are permitted.

common_host_shape.entry: One real exported finite component returned by the fixed thin bridge; arbitrary task-specific business branches remain local and finite.

ios.bridge_placement: Direct first child of eager host VStack inside the only vertical ScrollView.
ios.controls_and_metadata: Fixture update, receipt and runtime controls are outside the component scroll region.
ios.host_metadata_only: UUID, process information and uptime are observer epoch/event instrumentation, not inputs to production business state.
ios.native_terminal_guard: For a full sweep, the source queries exactly one current native terminal staticText, records frame and XCUIElement.isHittable with the capture binding; later independent registration requires actual inside-viewport terminal geometry and content end.
ios.runtime_obligation: Actual viewport/environment/scale, source compile identity, stable input/event epochs, exact original raster overlap and top/terminal boundaries remain required separately.
ios.terminal_placement: Immediate final child after the component; no later content inside the scroll content stack.

cell_enclosure.meaning: Conservative pixel-boundary enclosure of the exact recorded scalar, not measurement-error tolerance

geometry_encoding.claim_limit: Pixel-compatible registration does not prove exact native rectangle equality or waive any raw geometry/design assertion. Closed-domain, epochs and actual boundaries still required.

allowed: finite lossless IEEE754 binary64 JSON roundtrip
explicitly declared native binary32/integer losslessly promoted to that representation

pair_compatibility.motion: integer (0,-D), 0 < D < H for progressing down-link
pair_compatibility.predicate: For every eligible common identity, one common positive pixel rectangle exists in both candidate sets after translation; satisfy all edge displacement ranges AND direct sizes. Jointly preserve native order and independent non-overlapping witness boxes.
pair_compatibility.witnesses: At least two distinct actual leaves with disjoint raw/native and selected raster vertical support; no parent-child/coincident wrapper pairs

projection.arithmetic: Exact rational values of decoded native numbers and independently verified map parameters; no floating floor/ceil after cancellation
projection.not_source_of_truth: A guessed image_frame, fitted density or viewport selected to improve pixel agreement
requirements: fixed native coordinate origin and native-to-PNG provenance
actual viewport crop maps to integral PNG rectangle W x H
same W/H/color representation for the pair
raw native anchor strictly inside native viewport; no tolerant flag substitution

geometry_encoding.purpose: Conservative integer-raster registration compatibility only; never native style/geometry equality

raster_selection.D: Unique integer satisfying all native constraints AND exact complete-width overlap RGBA equality
raster_selection.search: Lossless exact pixel search over geometry-admissible integer candidates; rounding a float is never approval
